heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy south; partly to mostly cloudy north. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60. Winds becoming light and variable east of the Greens, becoming  south to southeast 5 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains westward.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of drizzle over high terrain, from the Green Mountains eastward; otherwise a chance of showers mid to late afternoon in far northern New York, and a slight chance farther east near the Québec border. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. Southeast winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming south and gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely, with a few embedded thunderstorms. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60 east of the Greens, upper 50s to mid 60s west. South to southeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
